title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.22237v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agents increasingly rely on repeated access to external artifacts, yet current reading interfaces often expose entire objects even when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute task-relevant evidence, while existing context-reduction methods mainly intervene after broad content has already entered the trajectory. We present SparseRead, a training-free, model-transparent reading layer that controls content admission before unnecessary evidence reaches the model context. SparseRead combines a regime-aware Read Gate, extensible Reader Backends, and a stateful protocol for bounded, source-anchored evidence acquisition with explicit refinement, verification, stopping, and fallback. Across six frontier models, including Claude Opus 5, and five workload scenarios, SparseRead reduces token volume by up to 92.9% and wall time by up to 89.0%, while preserving or improving task

translated_title: 读得更少，解决更多：面向AI代理的令牌高效稀疏读取
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22237v1 公告类型：新 摘要：长时程代理越来越依赖于对外部工件的重复访问，然而当前的读取接口即使只需要稀疏证据，也常常暴露整个对象。这种过度读取增加了令牌和延迟成本，并可能稀释任务相关证据，而现有的上下文缩减方法主要是在广泛内容已进入轨迹之后进行干预。我们提出了SparseRead，一个无需训练、模型透明的读取层，在多余证据到达模型上下文之前控制内容准入。SparseRead结合了感知模式的读取门控、可扩展的读取后端，以及一个有状态协议，用于有界、源锚定的证据获取，并带有明确的细化、验证、停止和回退机制。在包括Claude Opus 5在内的六个前沿模型和五个工作负载场景中，SparseRead将令牌量减少高达92.9%，墙钟时间减少高达89.0%，同时保持或改善任务性能。
tldr: SparseRead通过前置的稀疏读取控制层，在证据进入模型上下文前进行智能筛选，显著减少令牌和延迟成本，同时保持或提升任务性能。
en_tdlr: SparseRead uses a pre-context sparse reading layer to intelligently filter evidence before it reaches the model, significantly reducing token and latency costs while preserving or improving task performance.
